title: Open Deposits opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the deposit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer B was picked.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Click "Open Deposits" in the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The error toast shows with "Open Deposits".

Step 4:

  • Customer B's Deposits tab opens.
  • It lists the $10.00 deposit.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R6: “"Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share of the deposits.”
  • Key Decisions: “Deposits lock the Bill To. A deposit belongs to the Bill To it was taken under and never moves between customers. The refusal names the amount and payer and opens the payer's Deposits tab. A payment may use only deposits and credits held by the paying customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Click" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-08-after-click.png

The design's own words:

  • “Error toast with the same words, "Open Deposits" and "Close". "Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share.”
